voronoi.interpretation: Voronoi cell volumes partition the geometric domain; they are not treated as atomic solid occupied volume. Surface-sensitive atoms are reported separately and excluded from the interior comparison.

temperature.group_temperature_note: LAMMPS compute temp removes translational degrees of freedom from the DOF count but does not subtract group COM velocity from kinetic energy; both that value and an explicitly COM-removed diagnostic are reported. Cellwise temperatures remove local mean velocity.
